jobs.title: Regional Director- Business Development, Private Enterprise
jobs.description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

KPMG is a leading professional services firm providing a comprehensive suite of solutions to our clients. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional value, strategic insights, and tailored financial and operational services to businesses in our communities.

We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Director of Business Development to lead our sales initiatives and drive growth across our local offices. In this role, you will be the face of our firm in your designated local geography, tasked with building robust relationships with private companies. You will leverage your strong financial acumen to understand clients' complex needs and articulate the full breadth of our services. Furthermore, you will act as a key liaison, working seamlessly with internal partners to deliver comprehensive solutions, while leading the overall sales function, running key meetings, and reporting on pipeline metrics.

What You Will Do

Relationship Building & Market Expansion

Proactively identify, target, and build strong relationships with key decision-makers and C-level executives at private companies within the local geography.
Act as a brand ambassador, networking extensively within the local business community to uncover new opportunities and expand market share.
Establish and execute territory-specific business development strategies to expand market presence and revenue opportunities.
Act as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for prospective and existing business partners.
Attend networking events, industry conferences, community engagements, and stakeholder meetings to increase visibility and generate leads.

Sales Leadership & Pipeline Management

Lead the overarching sales function for the local offices you cover, establishing a culture of high performance and strategic growth.
Manage and coordinate critical sales meetings, presentations, and pitches to prospective clients.
Rigorously track and manage the sales pipeline, providing regular reporting on key initiatives, conversion rates, and revenue projections to senior leadership.
Maintain a robust pipeline of opportunities and ensure timely progression through the sales process.
Collaborate with leadership to establish sales goals, forecasts, and performance metrics.

Strategic Client Engagement & Financial Acumen

Utilize deep financial acumen to analyze client business models, understand their financial objectives, and identify areas where our firm can add quantifiable value.
Confidently discuss and cross-sell our full breadth of services, tailoring the value proposition to address specific financial and operational challenges.
Work closely with internal partners, operational teams, marketing, and leadership to align business development activities with organizational priorities.
Coordinate internal resources to support client engagement, proposal development, and implementation activities.
Facilitate communication between external partners and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery and relationship management.
Contribute insights on market trends, customer needs, and competitive intelligence to support strategic planning.

Internal Collaboration & Partnership

Partner collaboratively with internal subject matter experts, practice leaders, and delivery teams to craft comprehensive, multi-service proposals.
Facilitate smooth handoffs from the sales process to the execution teams, ensuring client expectations are clearly communicated and met.
Drive internal alignment on go-to-market strategies and participate in strategic planning sessions.

What You Bring To The Role

Experience Minimum of 7 years of proven experience in B2B business development, sales leadership, or a related field, preferably within professional services, commercial real estate, or financial services.
Financial Acumen Strong understanding of corporate finance, financial statements, and business operations, with the ability to engage in high-level financial discussions with business owners and executives.
Relationship Management Demonstrated track record of building and maintaining a network of contacts within private companies and local business communities.
Communication Skills Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills. Ability to translate complex service offerings into compelling value propositions.
Leadership Experience leading sales initiatives, managing pipelines (CRM proficiency), and reporting on key performance indicators.
Collaboration Highly collaborative team player with a history of successfully navigating matrixed organizations and working alongside internal partners to close deals.
Education Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field. (MBA, CPA or relevant advanced degree is a plus).

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

New business opportunities generated
Growth and quality of sales pipeline
Number of strategic relationships established and maintained
Revenue, partnership, or business development targets achieved
Conversion rates across sales stages
Client and partner engagement metrics
Timeliness and accuracy of reporting
Achievement of initiative and project milestones
Internal stakeholder satisfaction and collaboration effectiveness

Providing you with the support you need to be at your best

Our Values, The KPMG Way

Integrity
, we do what is right | Excellence
, we never stop learning and improving | Courage
, we think and act boldly | Together
, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better
, we do what matters

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778.

AI Usage

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Financial Services
